import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { removeBackendCaveFormation } from '@src/api/bot/cave-formation-actions';
import { BackendAPIError } from '@src/api/bot/client';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

function removalMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof BackendAPIError && error.code === 'CAVE_FORMATION_INVALID_KEYWORD') {
    return '未找到可移除的阵法，请输入阵法名称，例如：/移除阵法 冻结阵盘';
  }

  return error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : '移除阵法失败，请稍后重试';
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const keyword = (e.MessageText || '').replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?移除阵法\s*/, '').trim();

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!keyword) {
    md.addText('用法：/移除阵法 阵法名称');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例：/移除阵法 冻结阵盘');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '移除阵法', content: md, footer: [{ label: '洞府阵法', command: '/洞府阵法' }] }));

    return;
  }

  const footer = [
    { label: '洞府阵法', command: '/洞府阵法' },
    { label: '万宝楼', command: '/商店 万宝楼' }
  ];

  try {
    const result = await removeBackendCaveFormation(bid, e.uid as number, keyword, createBackendRequestContext(e));

    md.addText(`你已移除【${result.name}】。`);
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '移除成功', content: md, footer }));
  } catch (error) {
    md.addText(removalMessage(error));
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '移除失败', content: md, footer }));
  }
});
